formulas.formula: Ten paychecks, twelve months of bills. This plan makes summer easy.
1. Setup: when your school year starts, which month your pay starts, how many months you're paid, and your take-home per paycheck.
2. Budget: plan one normal month. Include a Summer fund line.
3. Summer Plan: see your summer gap and exactly how much to save from each paycheck to cover the months with no pay.
4. Transactions: log spending. Moving money to your summer savings? Use the Summer fund category.
5. Classroom: every supply you buy for your students, with receipts, for the educator expense deduction.
6. Side Income: tutoring, summer school, stipends.
7. Monthly and Dashboard: your whole school year, month by month.
On a 10-month salary, 2 months have no paycheck. Save a little from every check and summer is stress-free.
US teachers can deduct classroom supplies up to a yearly limit (check the IRS limit). Keep receipts.
Tick Reimbursed if the school paid you back. Those don't count as your spending.
Months here follow your school year (for example Aug to Jul), not January to December.
Clear the white cells on Budget, Transactions, Classroom and Side Income, then update Setup.
Tinted cells: these calculate for you.
Yellow: summer months, or almost there.
Red: behind, over budget, or something to check.
You teach the future. Here's to a relaxing, fully funded summer.
Set this up once. Everything else uses it.
A date, e.g. Aug 1. Blank = Aug 1 of this school year.
="School year "&R16&": paid "&R9&" months, "&(12-R9)&" month"&IF(12-R9=1,"","s")&" without a paycheck."
How much to save from each paycheck so the months without pay are covered.
=IF(C9<=0,"No summer gap. Your summer is covered.",REPT("█",ROUND(MIN(1,MAX(0,C10/C9))*10,0))&REPT("░",10-ROUND(MIN(1,MAX(0,C10/C9))*10,0))&"  "&TEXT(MIN(1,C10/C9),"0%")&" of your summer gap saved.")
=IF(C9<=0,"",IF(C11=0,"Summer is fully funded. Enjoy it.","Save "&TEXT(C15,"$#,##0")&" from each paycheck to be ready."))
Plan one normal month. Spent comes from Transactions for this month of the school year.

=IF(R4<=0,"Add your take-home on Setup.",IF(C25>R4,"Your plan is "&TEXT(C25-R4,"$#,##0")&" more than a paid month. Trim something.","Your plan fits a paid month with "&TEXT(R4-C25,"$#,##0")&" to spare."))
=IF(R5<=0,"",IF(N(C17)>=R5,"Summer fund plan: "&TEXT(N(C17),"$#,##0")&" a month. On track.","Summer fund plan is "&TEXT(N(C17),"$#,##0")&". The Summer Plan needs "&TEXT(R5,"$#,##0")&" a month."))
What you spend. Moving money into summer savings? Use the Summer fund category.
Supplies you buy for your classroom. Tick Receipt when you have one, and Reimbursed if the school paid you back.
Money from outside your teaching paycheck: tutoring, summer school, stipends, lesson-plan sales.
